answer: The delta edge is published both ways, so a closed ring of 161 clones produces a signature the vault analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. A hostile operator must as a result build an open graph reaching real agents, and hence doing work rather than printing keys, and the harbor settlement applies the void retroactively. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
